mapper.sql: sa.id, sa.sid, sa.course_id, sa.reason, sa.status, sa.apply_time, sa.approve_uid, sa.approve_time, st.name AS student_name, c.name AS course_name, cl.name AS clazz_name, c.credit
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO selection_apply (sid, course_id, reason, status, apply_time) VALUES (#{sid}, #{courseId}, #{reason}, 0, #{applyTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM selection_apply sa LEFT JOIN student st ON sa.sid = st.sid LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON st.cid = cl.cid LEFT JOIN course c ON sa.course_id = c.course_id WHERE sa.id = #{id}
